Definition: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
BiblicalUsage: ʼErets is the earth — the whole world God made, and also the land He gave to Israel. In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth, and the earth is the LORD's and the fullness thereof. It is the ground under every story in the Bible, from Eden to the new earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼerets keeps me grounded: the earth is God's, not ours, and He gave it to us as stewards. I hold that caring for the land and longing for the new earth belong together, because both honour the Maker.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
